name: Kiss Cam AI
tagline: Kiss Cam AI turns two photos into the Coldplay kiss cam meme: a 12-second video of you two caught on the jumbotron
description: Kiss Cam AI recreates the viral "caught on kiss cam" Coldplay affair moment around your own photos. Upload two solo photos (and pick who ducks and who hides their face) or one photo of both people. The AI puts them on its own AI-made stadium jumbotron, in their own clothes, and plays the whole 12-second moment: on the big screen, caught, hide and duck, and the crowd losing it. Output is a vertical 9:16 720p MP4 with crowd sound and no watermark, rendered in about 3 minutes in any browser with no app. Failed renders get the credit back automatically, photos are deleted within 24 hours and never used for training. Independent tool; no Coldplay music, logos or concert footage.
